tracks.title: 夜明けの散歩
tracks.lrc:
[00:04.00]静かな駅で始発を待ってる
[00:09.50]白い息がゆっくり空に溶けた
[00:15.00]まだ名前のない朝の光
[00:20.50]君に届くまで歩いていこう
[00:26.00]
[00:31.00]遠い街の灯りが消えていく
[00:36.50]線路沿いに咲いた小さな花
[00:42.00]今日だけはゆっくり進もう
[00:47.50]夜明けの散歩 ふたりで
[00:54.00]
tracks.romalrc:
[00:04.00]shizuka na eki de shihatsu o matteru
[00:09.50]shiroi iki ga yukkuri sora ni toketa
[00:15.00]mada namae no nai asa no hikari
[00:20.50]kimi ni todoku made aruite ikou
[00:31.00]tooi machi no akari ga kiete iku
[00:36.50]senro zoi ni saita chiisana hana
[00:42.00]kyou dake wa yukkuri susumou
[00:47.50]yoake no sanpo futari de

tracks.title: Folded Signals
tracks.lrc:
[00:03.50]Counting paper satellites
[00:08.50]Folded from the evening news
[00:13.50]I throw them past the city lights
[00:18.50]Hoping one of them gets through
[00:24.00]
[00:29.00]Every signal finds a way
[00:34.00]Every echo finds a room
[00:39.00]Keep a window open wide
[00:44.00]I'll be landing somewhere soon
[00:50.00]
